verdict.rationale: llama.cpp exposes a traditional CLI/server with flag-based invocation (llama cli, llama serve) and a chat UI for talking to the model, but there's no evidence of operating the tool itself via natural-language commands (e.g., agentic control of build/run/config tasks). missing for 10: any documentation of NL-driven command interpretation, agentic tool-use layer, or evidence users can issue plain-English instructions to control llama.cpp's own operation rather than chat with the loaded model.
